subject: general
question:
**Select the option that expresses the given sentence in direct voice.**

The manager told the team that their hard work and dedication had been noticed and appreciated.

options.text: The manager said, "Your hard work and dedication had been noticed and appreciated."
The manager said, "Your hard work and dedication have been noticed and appreciated."
The manager told the team, "Their hard work and dedication had been noticed and appreciated."
The manager said, "Their hard work and dedication were noticed and appreciated."

solution:
The correct answer is '2' i.e. The manager said, "Your hard work and dedication have been noticed and appreciated."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• To express the sentence in direct voice, we need to focus on the exact words spoken by the speaker.
 
• The direct speech should retain the original meaning and tense as conveyed in the indirect speech.
 
• The indirect sentence states that the manager told the team their hard work and dedication "had been noticed and appreciated," which implies past perfect tense. However, in direct speech, the context changes slightly to present perfect tense, as it reflects the immediate recognition.

Correct sentence: *The manager said, "Your hard work and dedication have been noticed and appreciated."*.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Understanding Direct Speech:**
 
 
• Direct speech involves quoting the exact words spoken by a person, enclosed in quotation marks.
 
• Example: He said, "I am going to the park."
 
 
 
• **Understanding Indirect Speech:**
 
 
• Indirect speech paraphrases what was said, often adjusting tense and pronouns.
 
• Example: He said that he was going to the park.
